corrected_scoring.primary: post-cooldown eval: a linear cooldown of 24 steps (13.3% of the 180-step constant-LR budget) appended after the banked matched-exposure landing, same stream/data order, LR factor (25 - k)/24 for cooldown step k (1.0 -> 1/24, never zero), both hybrid groups scaling equally; the corrected score is the post-cooldown calibration eval
corrected_scoring.secondary: EMA iterate at step 180 (no extra data): decay 0.99, initialized at the init weights, updated after every constant-phase optimizer step, NOT updated during the cooldown; RANKING-ONLY -- its absolute number is biased toward mid-run weights (stated, not smoothed)
corrected_scoring.exposure_note: the cooldown steps see ~2.7M more targets (~13%), identical across arms -- a stated protocol EXTENSION; the step-180 constant-LR eval is retained so every banked row stays comparable

citations.river_valley: Wen et al., ICLR 2025, arXiv:2410.05192 -- constant-LR loss carries an LR-dependent oscillation penalty that decay/averaging removes
citations.cooldown: Haegele et al., NeurIPS 2024, arXiv:2405.18392 -- constant-LR + short cooldown matches cosine at full scale
citations.averaging: Defazio et al., arXiv:2405.15682 -- iterate averaging as the schedule-free fix for the same penalty
citations.moonlight: Liu et al. (Moonshot AI), arXiv:2502.16982 -- with the update RMS matched to AdamW's (~0.2; AdamW typical 0.2-0.4), Muon directly reuses the LR and weight decay tuned for AdamW, i.e. ~1x the AdamW-tuned LR, WITH weight decay
citations.horizon: Bjorck et al., ICLR 2025 -- the optimal LR shrinks with token horizon; probe-tuned LRs transfer only downscaled

score_form: the K15 composed machine (the K13 additive read under the K11B p3 per-channel gate stack) at the bracket's LR/optimizer points -- the machine is NOT the lane's variable, the optimizer config is

muon4x.note: the K15 composition arm's own landed rows (the inherited point, both seeds banked) -- cited, never re-run

adamw.note: the composed machine under PLAIN AdamW at its own tuned point (1x the tuned base, fused, the bake-off's own adamw arm's convention) -- the optimizer-family check: the read-form change may have moved the optimizer ranking

muon2x.note: the composed machine + hybrid Muon at 2x the tuned AdamW base -- the bracket's near side

muon3x.note: the composed machine + hybrid Muon at 3x -- the inherited bracket point both machines' brackets started from

muon6x.note: the composed machine + hybrid Muon at 6x -- the far side past the inherited 4x point

rule.rule: the best cell of the bracket -- the lowest post-cooldown row at seed 3401 across muon2x / muon3x / muon4x (cited) / muon6x / adamw -- is the composed machine's search-symmetric best cell and owes its second seed (3402), UNLESS it is the 4x cell (the K15 composition arm already landed at both seeds; the pair is complete and no new run is owed)
rule.cited_cell: muon4x (the K15 composition arm's own rows at both seeds)
rule.escalation: any bracket cell whose post-cooldown row lands at or below GDN2's 1.3521734476089478 is reported with BOTH scorings and BOTH seeds before any claim -- and escalated, not adjudicated here

second_seed_adjudication.note: the 4x cell's pair is complete (the K15 arm landed at both seeds); any other best cell owes seed 3402

gap_quote_vs_gdn2.caveat: the endpoint-variance band (0.075) and the winner's seed delta (0.0119) are quoted with every margin; the composed-machine-vs-GDN2 row is a cross-machine context row at the same probe protocol, not a controlled comparison; the final gap-quote phrasing is the supervisor's to adjudicate (the K13 clause-conflict precedent)

config_yield_vs_inherited_4x.note: how much of the remaining ~0.03 the bracket's config axis owned (the same-seed read vs the inherited 4x row); if the inherited point was already optimal this is 0 and the config-symmetry duty is discharged by receipt

notes.scoring: PRIMARY: post-cooldown (24-step linear); SECONDARY: EMA-0.99 at step 180 (ranking-only); constant-180 retained for banked comparability
notes.bands: every margin is read against BOTH the 0.075-nat endpoint-variance band and the winner's 0.0119 seed delta
notes.pre_state: NO directional prediction was pre-stated on the bracket's outcome; the config-symmetry duty is discharged by receipt either way (the inherited point optimal is a receipt, not a null result)
notes.escalation: the final gap-quote phrasing and any quality-conclusion inversion are escalated to the supervisor (the K13 clause-conflict precedent governs adjudication)
